_doc: Allowed levers for the nightly experiment loop (experiment_loop.py). ONLY these levers and values can ever be applied. Order = test queue. Every value must render cleanly (hook/cta '' = no card; music_volume is the documentary music bed, default config.DOC_MUSIC_VOLUME 0.10). length 'short' (2026-11-12) = a 50-60 word script and a loop end; judged on views@72h, since a shorter video gets a higher % watched for free.

levers.hypothesis: Dropping the 1.8s hook title card (straight into the spoken cold open) raises avg % watched; research says a cold open beats a title card.

A 20-25 s case (50-60 words) whose end dissolves back into its first frame gets watched through and replayed, which TikTok rewards with more views than the 32-38 s video (every post lands at 702-740; viewers stay ~7 s).

A small place-and-year tag in the first 3 seconds (only when both are in the case's source) gives every video something of its own from the first frame, raising avg % watched and making videos less alike (view-cap research 2026-11-10).
Ending on the payoff line with no end card raises avg % watched (viewers leave at the outro).
A quieter music bed makes the narration clearer and raises avg % watched.
